answer: A proposed market accepts earning keys only with 3 endorsements from disjoint approved trust branches; each alias occupies 3 sponsor slots for a 30-day permit. The registry checks signatures and root paths, locks each sponsor to 1 live key and rejects reused slots; expired permits cannot earn. Ten aliases need 30 sponsors. An ivory dealer, walnut buyer or sonnet seller faces the same gate. Public signed logs expose double-vouching for root revocation. Scarce, independently governed roots are essential; secret root cartels can still admit fakes.
